records.source: How cells become gene profiles: lof (1 drops the 1% intensity outliers), impute ('median' or 'knn'), pca ('c0' per-well standardised, or 'brieflow'), agg ('guide' = median of guide medians, 'gene' = median of all cells, or 'gene_trim' = their 10% trimmed mean), nt ('pseudo' = four control guides per pseudo-gene, or 'barcode') and tvn ('spacr', or 'brieflow' = Brieflow's control axes). The Hybrid profile is lof 1, knn, brieflow, gene, barcode, brieflow with whitening epsilon 0. Empty is lof 0, median, c0, guide, pseudo, spacr. Default None. Alpha.
records.translation: Cómo las células se convierten en perfiles génicos: lof (1 descarta el 1% de valores atípicos de intensidad), impute ('median' o 'knn'), pca ('c0' estandarizado por pocillo, o 'brieflow'), agg ('guide' = mediana de las medianas de guía, 'gene' = mediana de todas las células, o 'gene_trim' = su media recortada al 10%), nt ('pseudo' = cuatro guías control por pseudogén, o 'barcode') y tvn ('spacr', o 'brieflow' = los ejes de control de Brieflow). El perfil Hybrid es lof 1, knn, brieflow, gene, barcode, brieflow con épsilon de blanqueo 0. Vacío equivale a lof 0, median, c0, guide, pseudo, spacr. Predeterminado None. Alfa.
